items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: He used to play baritone like Harry Carney.

ctx.x: Even Roland Kirk, who you have to say put a little bit of thought into what he was going to do, I mean, you wouldn’t imagine playing three saxophones was a good idea just one day and decide to go and do it. It evolved. And he was an evolving cat too. He used to play baritone like Harry Carney. And flute. He turned into a great flute player at a time when flute was still new and everybody was getting one. His sound was so far ahead of everybody.

Well I’m going to try one last question on you, then we’ll wrap up. You just used the word “evolve.” Some people feel that jazz music helped to bring blacks and whites together before it happened in the rest of society. I wonder if you have a thought about that?
